brief:
Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese called for the urgent deployment of an international protection force in the West Bank and Gaza, the Ma'an news agency reported. The statement underscored mounting international concern over the deteriorating security situation in the Palestinian territories and the toll on civilian populations.

International protections forces have been proposed by various global actors as a potential mechanism to shield civilians from ongoing violence and create conditions for de-escalation. Albanese's appeal reflected broader diplomatic efforts to address the humanitarian dimensions of conflict in both the occupied West Bank and the Gaza Strip through multilateral intervention and international security measures.
title: Albanese calls for urgent international protection force in West Bank and Gaza.
